title: Fix jmap-vtc-chat-delegation-guide.md: 16 issues including fabricated fields + wrong API
description: MUST-FIX: (1) Lines 352-419: lobby Chat architecture requires a VTC field that doesn't exist — guide invents a second lobby Chat id but VTCCall has no field to store it. (2) Line 303: Reaction via Message/set is wrong API — Reaction is its own data type, use Reaction/set create. (3) Lines 387-388: 'permissionOverrides' field doesn't exist in Chat or VTC spec — fabricated name. (4) VTCRingEvent doesn't carry chatId (only VTCCallPush does) — guide implies both paths provide binding. (5) Lines 108-109, 412: 'add to Chat members list' wrong mutation path — should use addMembers/removeMembers patch keys. (6) Lines 381-383: channel-as-lobby requires a Space to exist — guide omits this prerequisite. SHOULD-FIX: (7) Line 329: invalid JSON surrogate pair \ud83d\udc4f — should be literal emoji. (8) Lines 448-451: PresenceStatus.expiresAt resets to 'online' (SHOULD), not 'clears'. (9) Lines 301-306: Reaction mechanism omits senderReactionId and JSON Pointer patch requirement. (10) Lines 285-286: bodyType mischaracterized as semantic marker for transcripts. (11) Chat.muted bypass by broadcast mentions not noted. (12) expiresAt presence reset is SHOULD not MUST. (13) Missing start_call permission check for Space-bound calls. (14) Lines 453-455: ChatPresenceEvent conflated with federation propagation path. EDITORIAL: (15) Lines 63, 131, 507-519: vague/inconsistent section citations. (16) Line 131: unresolvable cross-reference.
close_reason: All issues fixed across 11 VTC files
